column1: # Wiki-sourced item rows: one data row per item, appended by scripts/gen_osrs_item_rows.py into osrs_items_wiki_rows.h
# (enum, ITEM_DATABASE row, attack style, raw-id aliases). Hand rows in osrs_items_generated.h stay as they are.
# Add an item in three steps:
#   1. Append a row. Every number is the OSRS Wiki "Combat stats" infobox of that item (wiki_url) at the version
#      whose id is raw_id. slot is the sim slot; weapons carry attack_speed (ticks), attack_range (tiles; magic
#      staffs that autocast use 10 like the hand staff rows) and style (melee/ranged/magic); two_handed is the wiki
#      "2h" slot. aliases: further raw ids with the same stats (charged / ornament / locked variants).
#      A new row is APPENDED, never inserted: indexes and observation codes of existing rows must not move.
#      then build ocean/osrs/tests/test_wiki_item_rows.c (cc -std=c11 -O2 -I. ... -lm) and run it.
# Budget: item index < 255 with OSRS_STAT_ITEM_SLOTS run-time rows after the table (scripts check >= 40 free), and
# OSRS_ITEM_CONTENT_COUNT <= OSRS_ITEM_OBS_CODE_SCALE (512, GEN_OBS_CODE_SCALE in gen_osrs_item_obs_table.c; the generator refuses more).
# Specials are NOT here: a weapon with a special the sim does not model has spec cost 0; modelled ones are hand code in osrs_special_attacks.h.
